name: Prayer Social And Family
overview: The Scriptures reveal that prayer within social and family contexts is foundational to faithful living, as seen in Abram's journey where he called upon the name of the LORD after settling in Canaan (Genesis 12:5,8). Jacob exemplified the importance of purifying the household and seeking God together, building altars and acknowledging God's presence and answers in times of distress (Genesis 35:2-3,7). Joshua's declaration to serve the LORD with his household (Joshua 24:15) underscores the commitment to lead family and social spheres in worship and obedience to God.
